context: Sho-young watches his first anime episode with Kenji and is excited.
purpose: Uncle and child sharing pop-culture moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 健司おじちゃん、アニメ、最高!
lines.en: Kenji-ojichan, that anime was the best!
lines.style: Bright, breathless excitement. Quick attack on the opening. Warm rush of words—the pure unselfconscious joy of a six-year-old sharing something he loves. Small hitch of breath between thought and next word.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 主人公、ええキャラやろ?
lines.en: The main character's pretty great, isn't he?
lines.style: Soft Kansai warmth. Gentle, indulgent tone—the adult delighted to be included in a child's enthusiasm. Relaxed pace, almost conspiratorial, like he's remembering why he loves it too.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: The adventure—it makes my heart race!
lines.style: Immediate, eager energy. Slight breathless quality on 「ワクワク」—he's feeling it right now, not performing it. Quick, open vowels. The voice of discovery, present-tense wonder.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Warm, gentle teasing with real affection underneath. Light laugh underneath the words—not mocking, but amused and charmed. Relaxed Kansai cadence, soft attack, slight playful drawl.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Urgent, insistent but not whiny. Quick attack, bright open sound. The persistence of a child who's found something that matters. Small note of pleading—not demanding, just hopeful.
